_note: MODULE TIER (ADR-029 D1). A server describing its own NFS shares consumes nothing, so its exports are a module-tier object of its own rather than a config."pvehost:nfs" block (that block is the consumer's: its mounts). A cluster node builds what it declares here; a registered, unmanaged server (ADR-029 D2a) declares descriptors of what already exists.

nfs.description: The NFS shares this machine serves (ADR-029 D4, D2a). On a cluster node each exports[] entry becomes the dataset <pool>/tappaas-nfs/<name>, shared through ZFS sharenfs to the consumers it grants; on a registered, unmanaged server each entry describes a share that already exists, by path.

exports.description: One entry per share. Managed node: {name, pool, quota?, properties?, backup: {enabled, exclude?}, grants[], owner?}. Registered server: {name, path, version?, v3Ports?, grants[]}. owner is allocated (64000-64999) and written back on first build; backup.enabled has no default and must be stated.

nfs.note: The data belongs to the export, never to a consumer (ADR-029 D6): removing an export unshares it and keeps the dataset; only an explicit purge destroys it. A consumer never creates an export — a mount naming one that is not declared here is refused (D11).
